spans.s:
(क, त) r. 10th cl. (अंगयति)
1 To mark.
2 To count. See अङ्क.

n. (-ङ्गं)
1 A limb or member.
2 A division of Hindu learning, comprehending such science as is considered dependant upon the Vedas, hence also called Vedāṅga; works on six subjects come under this description, viz. pronunciation, grammar, prosody, explanation of obscure terms, description of religious rites, and astronomy.
3 The body.
4 An expedient, a means of success.
5 Mind, understanding.
6 A term in grammar, the inflective root, with the affix subjoined-
7 (Sing. only,) Chief, principal.
8 Inferior, secondary.
9 All [] the dramatis personoe of a play, except the hero and heroine, the body of the characters.
10 (In rhetoric.) An incidental passion or figure, illustrative of, but subordinate to the main object of the description.
11 A scriptural work in the Jain religion; there are twelve works so named.
m. (ङ्गः)
A country, Bengal proper, including Bhāgalpur.
mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
1 Corporeal, embodied.
2 Near, proximate.
ind.
1 A vocative particle.
2 Again, further, the rather.
3 A particle of assent used in composition, with ई substituted for the vowel termination, as in अङ्गीकरण, &c.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
1 Bodily, corporeal.
2 Having limbs or parts, or relating to them.
3 Relating to the inferior persons of a drama, to a portion of the Vedas, &c.: see अङ्ग.
m. (-ङ्गः)
A soft delicate form or body.
E.
अङ्ग a body, अण् aff.

n. (-कं)
1 The body, &c. See the preceding.
f. (अङ्गिका)
A bodice or jacket.
mfn. (-कः-का or -की-कं)
Relating to the body, &c.
E.
अङ्ग, कन् added.

m. (-कः)
1 The ruler of the country Aṅga.
2 An inhabitant of the same.
E.
अङ्ग and वुञ् aff.

m. (-हः)
Bodily pain.
E.
अङ्ग, and ग्रह what seizes.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं).
1 Produced or born of the body.
n. (-जं)
1

Blood.
2

Love, desire.
3 The hair of the head.
4 Sickness, disease.
5 A son.
f. (-जा)
A daughter.
E.
अङ्ग the body, and ज what is born; also similar compounds, as अङ्गजात, अङ्गजन्म, &c.

n. (-णं)
A court, or yard. See अङ्गन.

m. (-तिः)
1 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
2
A name of KṚṢṆ

Fire.
4

A Brahman, who has preserved a sacred fire.
E.
अगि to go, and अति aff.

m. (-दः)
1 The name of a celebrated monkey, one of the heroes of the Rāmāyaṇa, the son of BĀLI.
n. (-दं)
A bracelet worn upon the upper arm.
f. (-दा)
The female elephant of the south.
E.
अङ्ग the body, and दे to nourish, or दै to cleanse, aff. ड.

n. (-नं)
1 A court or yard.
2 Going, moving.
f. (-ना)
1 A woman, a female.
2 The sign

Virgo.
3

The female elephant of the north.
E.
अगि to go, and यच् aff.

n. (-णं)
A number of women.
E.
अङ्गना and गण troop.

m. (-नः)
A female, a female person.
E.
अङ्गना and जन a being.

m. (-यः)
A plant, (Jonesia asoka.) See अशोक.
E.
अङ्गना a woman, and प्रिय, beloved; worship being performed by women to this plant.

m. (-सः)
Touching various parts of the body, as a religious ceremony.
E.
अङ्ग, and न्यास arrangement.

m. (-लिः)
Embracing, an embrace.
E.
अङ्ग, and पाल to nourish, इन् aff.

n. (-त्तं)
Expiation for bodily impurity, especially the oblation offered by the heir at the first funeral obsequies, to remove the impurity contracted during the period of mourning.
E.
अङ्ग body and प्रायश्चित्त expiation.

m. (-र्द्दः)
A servant, whose business it is to rub and knead the body.
E.
अङ्ग, मृद् to rub, and अच् aff. Also अङ्गमर्द्दकः and अङ्गमर्द्दन.

n. (-क्तं)
A plant, vulg. Śuṇḍārocanī. See रक्ताङ्ग.
E.
अङ्ग, and रक्त red, giving a red dye.

f. (-णी)
1 Armour, coat of mail, thick quilting, or an iron netting worn upon the body.
2 A garment.
E.
अङ्ग, and रक्षिणी what preserves.

m. (-गः)
Perfuming the body after cleansing; smearing it with unguents of sandal, &c.
E.
अङ्ग, and राग colouring.

m. (-राट्)
A name of KARṆA, king of Aṅga, the son of KUNTĪ by SŪRYA. See कर्ण.
E.
अङ्ग the country so named, and राज् a king; also अङ्गराजा and अङ्गराज.

n. (-हं)
Hair of the body, wool, fleece, down.
E.
अङ्ग, and रुह what rises on.

m. (-ड्यः)
Ginger, (Amomum zinziber.) See चिञ्चाटक.
E.
अङ्ग, and लोड, to be mad, aff. यत्; exciting or stimulating the body.

m. (-न्धः)
A subdivision of a branch of science or philosophy.
E.
अङ्ग a part of science, and स्कन्ध division.

m. (-वः)
A dried or withered fruit.
E.
अङ्ग and य, from वै to dry or wither.

m. (-तिः)
Syncope, apoplexy.
E.
अङ्ग, and विकृति change of condition.

m. (-पः)
Gesture, gesticulation.
E.
अङ्ग, and विक्षेप throwing, moving.

n. (-तं)
Sign, token, hint.
E.
अङ्ग, and वैकृत change of form, &c.

m. (-रः)
Embellishment of person, dressing, cleansing or perfuming it.
E.
अङ्ग, and संस्कार making perfect.

f. (-तिः)
Bodily strength, or symmetry.
E.
अङ्ग, and संहति compactness.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Bodily union or contact, coition.
E.
अङ्ग, and सङ्ग union.

m. (-रः)
Gesture, gesticulation.
E.
अङ्ग, and हार taking, moving; also अङ्गहारि.

m. (-रिः)
See अङ्गहार.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Mutilated, maimed, defective.
E.
अङ्ग a limb, हीन deprived of.

ind.
Body and body, implying contact or co-operation.
E.
अङ्ग repeated with इ aff.

m. (-वः)
Personal relation or co-operation.
E.
अङ्गाङ्गि, and भाव nature.

m. (-पः)
A name of KARṆA, king of Aṅga. See कर्ण.
E.
अङ्ग the country, अधिप a ruler.

mn. (-रः-रं)
Charcoal, whether burning or not, but more usually the latter.
m. (-रः)
A name of the planet Mars; from his fiery colour.
E.
अगि to go, and आरन् aff.

n. (-रं)
A multitude of firebrands.
E.
अङ्गार a torch, अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 The planet

Mars.
2

Charcoal, burning or extinguished.
3 Yellow or white amaranth. See कुरुण्ठक.
4 Another plant, (Eclipta or Verbesina prostrata.) See भृङ्गराज.
n. (-कं)
A medicated oil, prepared by boiling turmeric and various vegetable substances in common oil.
E.
अङ्गार and कन् affix; resembling a burning brand.

m. (-णिः)
Coral.
E.
अङ्गारक, and मणि a gem.

f. (-का)
A small portable fire-place or fire-pan.
E.
अङ्गार, and घानिका what holds, from धा root, with the affs. ल्युट्^1, कन् and टाप्.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320. note: cf wil1819.

n. (-तं)
Roasted food.
E.
अङ्गार, and परिपाचित cooked.

m. (-र्णः)
A name of CITRARATHA, chief of the Gandharbas.

m. (-पः)
A plant, vulg. Ingua. See इङ्गुदी. The seeds are used for rosaries, &c.
E.
अङ्गार, and पुष्प a flower; the flowers supposed to resemble coals.

f. (-ञ्जी)
A tree, or shrub, (Cesalpinia bonducella.)
E.
अङ्गार, and मञ्जी a pedicle, compared to a coal.

f. (-री)
1 A species of Karanja, (Galedupa arborea.)
2 Another plant, (Ovieda verticillata^1, Rox.)
E.
अङ्गार and वल्लरी a compound pedicle.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

f. (-ल्ली)
See अङ्गारवल्लरी.

f. (-टी)
A small portable fire-pan.
E.
अङ्गार and शकटी a little cart.

f. (रिः)
A small portable fire-pan.
E.
अङ्गार and इन् aff.

f. (-क)
1 The stalk of the

Sugarcane.
2

The bud of the Kiṃśuka, (Butea frondosa.)
E.
अङ्गार, and कन् and टाप् affs.

f. (-णी)
1 A small portable fire-place.
2 The quarter from which the sun has departed.
E.
अङ्गार, and णिनि poss. aff. and fem. ङीप्.

n. (-तं)
The early blossom of the Kiṃśuka, (Butea frondosa).
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1

Burnt.
2

Charred.
E.
अङ्गार, and इतच् aff.

f. (-का)
A kind of bodice or jacket.
E.
अङ्ग the body, and इकन् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Bodily, corporeal.
2 Gesticulated, expressed by bodily action, (dramatic sentiment, passion, &c. exhibited by attitude, gesture, &c.)
m. (-कः)
A player on a tabor or drum.
E.
अङ्ग the body, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि)
1 Corporeal, bodily.
2 Limbed, having limbs or members.
3 Chief, principal.
E.
अङ्ग and इनि aff.

m. (-राः)
The name of a Ṛṣi or saint, born of BRAHMĀ, one of the seven principal sages; in one legend identified with fire, and apparently an astronomical personification, having for, his sons UTATHYA and VṚHASPATI, and for daughters Sinīvālī, Kuhū, Rākā, and Anumati.
E.
अगि to go, and असि Uṇādi aff. with इरक् inserted.

n. (-णं)
Promising, agreeing, assenting.
E.
अङ्ग a particle of assent, करण doing, च्ची inserted.

m. (-रः)
An agreement, a promise.
E.
अङ्ग a particle of asseveration, and कार making, from कृ to do. घञ inserted.

n. (-तः-ता-तं)
Agreed, promised.
E.
अङ्गी as before, and कृत participle of कृ.

f. (-रिः)
1 A finger.
2 A toe, also written अङ्गुरी. See अङ्गुलि.
E.
अङ्ग to count, and उरी Uṇādi aff.

mn. (-यः-यं)
A finger-ring. See अङ्गुलीयक.
E.
अङ्गुरी a finger, and य aff.

mn. (-कः-कं)
A finger-ring. See अङ्गुरीयक.
E.
कन् affixed to the preceding.

m. (-लः)
1 The thumb.
2 A finger.
3 A measure of eight barley corns.
4 The name of a saint. See वत्स्यायन.
5 A digit, or one-twelfth part of any dimension.
E.
अङ्ग to count, and उल aff.

f. (-लिः)
1 A finger.
2 The tip of an elephant's trunk.
3 A toe; also अङ्गली.
E.
अङ्ग to count, and उलि Uṇādi aff.

f. (-ली)
1 A finger.
2 The tip of an elephant's trunk. See अङ्गुलि.

n. (-णं)
Three semicircular lines drawn across the forehead, with sandal, &c. a sectarial mark, especially of the followers of Śakti.
E.
अङ्गुलि a finger, and तोरण the ornamented arch of a gateway, to which the mark made by the fingers upon the forehead may be compared.

n. (-त्रं)
A guard for the finger, applied to the bowstring used by archers.
E.
अङ्गुलि, and त्र what protects.

n. (-णं)
See the last.
E.
अङ्गुलि, and त्राण what protects.

n. (-खं)
The tip of the finger.
E.
अङ्गुलि, and मुख end.

f. (-द्रा)
A seal ring.
E.
अङ्गुलि, and मुद्रा a seal; also अङ्गुलिमुद्रिका.

n. (-नं)
Cracking, or snapping the finger joints.
E.
अङ्गुलि, and मोटन rubbing, from मुट aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-शः)
1 Snapping the finger joints.
2 Making signs, talking with the fingers.
E.
अङ्गुलि, and सन्देश information.

n. (-नं)
Snapping the fingers.
E.
अङ्गुलि, and स्फोटन bursting.

mn. (-कः-कं)
A finger ring.
E.
अङ्गुली, and कन् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Like a finger.
E.
अङ्गुली and ठक् aff.

n. (-कं)
The five fingers collectively.
E.
अङ्गुली, and पञ्चक a five.

n. (-कं)
A finger ring.
E.
see अङ्गुरीयक.

m. (-तः)
A finger nail.
E.
अङ्गुली, and सम्भूत born, produced.

m. (-ष्ठः)
The thumb.
E.
अङ्गु here said to be the hand, and ष्ठ, from स्था to stay.

m. (-षः)
1 An ichneumon.
2 An arrow.
E.
अगि to go, and ऊषः Uṇādi aff.

m. (-सः)
A name of VṚHASPATI, preceptor of the gods.
E.
अङ्गिरस् a saint so named, patronymic affix अण्; AṄGIRAS being the father of VṚHASPATI.
